pages.text: The research table is the first thing you'll need to craft most augments. Using it will open the research screen, this screen has multiple tabs. Each tab has a collection of research nodes.

Each research node will give you a short description of what it unlocks when you hover over it. By right-clicking whilst hovering over a node, you'll instead see the requirements needed to unlock it. This is typically a collection of items, and an experience point cost. If you have the items in your inventory, and the required experience, you can left click the research to unlock it.
